injuries.detail: Richard is deciding between getting surgery or playing with a splint, Luca Evans of the San Francisco Chronicle reports.
Payton (left knee soreness) is listed as questionable for Monday's game against New Orleans.
Santos (knee) is listed as probable for Monday's game against New Orleans.
Porzingis announced on his social media that he's stepping away from basketball.
Moody (knee) is progressing toward a potential return between December and January after rupturing his left patellar tendon in March, Anthony Slater of ESPN rep
Butler (knee) could return sometime between January and February as he continues recovering from a torn right ACL, Anthony Slater of ESPN reports.
Williamson (rest) is out for Monday's game against the Warriors.
Watford (ankle) is out for Monday's game versus Utah.
Murphy (knees) has been ruled out for Monday's game against Golden State.
Missi (knee) is out for Friday's game against Minnesota.
